post.description:
Compute a stage for the current answers again, after it failed or was cancelled.

Stages it waits on that failed or were cancelled are retried too. A stage
that is fresh, in flight or blocked is left as it is. Returns its status.

The views that show what recording ``decision`` would change. Nothing is recorded.

At most three views, the first primary. Once the split exists, held-out rows are never read.

CreateProject.title: CreateProject
CreateProject.description: Open a file on this machine by its path (local mode only).

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: A pack's badge: where the field stands, and the section that says so.

ProjectState.title: ProjectState
ProjectState.description: The fold of the decision log. Later milestones add slots as fields.

RangeByLevel.title: RangeByLevel
RangeByLevel.description: Different plausible ranges per level of another column (e.g. by sex).

Refusal.title: Refusal
Refusal.description: Every error the API answers itself; HTTP 409 when a decision is refused.

RelationshipView.title: RelationshipView
RelationshipView.description: A before/after scatter, e.g. a nutrient against energy before and after adjustment.

RowStep.title: RowStep
RowStep.description: One step of the participant flow (CONSORT/STROBE style).

SetExclusions-Input.title: SetExclusions
SetExclusions-Input.description: Row exclusions; an empty list is the answer "keep every row".

SetExclusions-Output.title: SetExclusions
SetExclusions-Output.description: Row exclusions; an empty list is the answer "keep every row".

SetRoles.title: SetRoles
SetRoles.description: The confirmed reading of every column except the outcome.

SetTask.title: SetTask
SetTask.description:
An override of task detection, for the outcome column it names.

It stands only while ``column`` is the target (see :func:`fold`).

TableFocusView.title: TableFocusView
TableFocusView.description: The working table narrowed to the columns this choice touches (≤ 12 shown, ≤ 8 rows).

CohortArtifact.description: The ``cohort`` artifact (a Bundle's ``data``): the participant flow.
CohortArtifact.title: CohortArtifact

DesignArtifact.description: The ``design`` artifact: each model's pipeline and the columns it will see.
DesignArtifact.title: DesignArtifact

EnergyReading.description: What the energy-adjustment question can offer on this table (NUTRITION_PACK §04).
EnergyReading.title: EnergyReading

ExclusionProposal.description: One of the pack's exclusion rules, with the rows it would remove. Never pre-selected.
ExclusionProposal.title: ExclusionProposal

FitArtifact.description: The ``fit`` artifact: cross-validated and held-out performance per model.
FitArtifact.title: FitArtifact

ProposalsArtifact.description: The ``proposals`` artifact: offered for the exclusions and energy questions.
ProposalsArtifact.title: ProposalsArtifact

RolesArtifact.description: The ``roles`` artifact: a proposed role for every column but the outcome.
RolesArtifact.title: RolesArtifact

ShelfArtifact.description: The ``shelf`` artifact: every family that can model the task, best first.
ShelfArtifact.title: ShelfArtifact

SplitArtifact.description: The ``split`` artifact (a Bundle's ``data``): held-out rows and folds.
SplitArtifact.title: SplitArtifact

SubstitutionArtifact.description: The ``substitution`` artifact: one curve per fitted model.
